messages:
maria: quick thought — can we add a small 'playback' control in the changelist rows so SREs / support can step through the sequence of changes for a tenant?
ajay: +1 to the idea. how do you imagine controls? step/next/back or a timeline scrub?
sophia: timeline scrub sounds nice in the console but fragile for large tenants. maybe a paged sequence + 'jump to timestamp'.
maria: yeah, my mental model: ordered actions (create/update/delete) with context. UI shows the diff and a compact header (actor, role, reason). a play button would iterate them and optionally attach logs.
elainE: @maria small nit — we need to ensure row-level visibility respects tenant-scoped permissions. support should not see cross-tenant justification text.
kevin: agree. for Private deployments we should honor tenant scoping and for Hosted we follow RBAC. simplest is to add a filter param to the playback API: tenant_id + actor_role_scope.
ajay: API sketch: 
```
GET /api/v1/audit/playback?tenant_id=tn_123&start_ts=1670000000&end_ts=1670003600&actor_scope=support
```
returns an ordered list of change events with compact delta and backrefs to full snapshots.
infra-bot: deploy queued for audit-service: feature/playback-api -> staging at 14:35 UTC :rocket:
compliance-bot: note: any playback endpoint must be logged and include requester identity (for compliance). also need retention gating if big tenants request long ranges.
sophia: retention gating is critical — we should show a warning in the console when the requested window > 7 days and offer a pre-packaged bundle download instead of inline playback.
maria: pre-packaged bundle download = signed archive of jsonl events (no PII), right?
kevin: yes, signed with key rotation metadata. we can reuse existing bundle signing infra but need a tenant-scoped permission to request.
ajay: UX question — should the bundle be generated on-demand or queued and emailed/console-notified? generation can be expensive.
els: queued + notification. show a lightweight preview in the UI (first 10 events) and a 'request full bundle' CTA.
kevin: telemetry: track playback_preview_shown, playback_played, bundle_requested, bundle_downloaded, and bundle_generation_time. also tag by tenant size and event_count to tune autoscaling.
maria: rollout plan: feature-flag on by tenant, start internal-only, then beta on customer accounts that sign NDA. need console copy for the warning + an admin audit to approve bundle requests.
sophia: one more: expose an audit reason override field for admin view only (not shown to support) so we preserve justification but control visibility.
compliance-bot: file a control ticket: CF-4312 to list required approvals and retention policy mapping.
ajay: I'll follow up with a PR for the API shape and a small mock console flow — ping me if you want to pair on the preview UX.
maria: thanks all. leaving a note: we must not call the feature 'export' in the UI, use 'bundle' or 'archive' to avoid misinterpretation with billing exports.
kevin: good call. +:thumbsup:
sophia: I'll add mock screenshots to the design doc and mark sensitive fields for redaction.
maria: filing tracking issue now and adding owners (ajay, sophia, kevin).
